private_interfaces.bounded_passes: Complete validated successful BFX <=3840 instructions plus byte01; trusted header/count, not untrusted decoders. Validate result before publishing.
private_interfaces.stream_packer: Validated canonical success; opaque non-unit encoded operations including CLEAR pass through. Coordinator checks header/identifier/status/count but does not replace full decoder validation.
private_interfaces.source_failure: Scalar failure discards all provisional buffers and emits no BFX success record.

decoder_closure.construction: Read-only dependency projection of the exact canonical decoder already introduced by canonical_importer.edit; no second decoder implementation. Full verify_store and Workspace.save.
decoder_closure.rejected_legacy_build_root_edit: Unchanged reference edit service failed sorting PACKAGE module references (XAX.CANON.ULEB_UNTERMINATED). Legacy BUILD package is retired; the new portable source is the shared canonical decoder closure.

findings_and_repairs.finding: The prior private run-packer accepted only transparent ASCII tokens. Repacking canonical CLEAR byte zero could confuse it with empty pending state and coalesce/remove operations.
findings_and_repairs.repair: A BF guard allows equality/coalescing only for recognized ASCII unit operations. CLEAR and encoded tags flush the pending run and pass through. The corrected source is natively compiled, specialized through verified canonical transactions and replaces the old embedded core.
findings_and_repairs.validation: Four independent opaque/zero packets; 1800 native private packets per target; 215 complete packing records per target; full optimization-level programs.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Reference edit of the old decoder BUILD/package wrapper was declined by unchanged generic package sorting with XAX.CANON.ULEB_UNTERMINATED.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Retire the wrapper and save the exact shared decoder FUNCTION dependency closure from the verified importer. No second decoder implementation.

retirement_checks.retired_decoder_selection: Standalone decoder closure functions and imported decoder ABI (seven typed parameters, old record view at parameter one), compared against every current BFX integration store.

android_authority.execution: NDK transports call the shared-object exports directly with dlopen/dlsym. No interpreter or alternative implementation exists in the transports. Authority is registered after device execution and device/library digest verification.

limitations: Native component execution is distinct from native XAX compiler-host completion. Generic Windows verification/lowering/packaging and helper-loader fallback remain disclosed.

Initial generic SDK snapshot matches 3dcb358e48b0f9a45b8cb72767c1aa600e55cd78. This migration edits no generic SDK files. Unrelated upstream hash-span construction addition is preserved; all eight component images rebuild identically afterward.
Five maximum instruction imports establish native emission, target equality and canonical storage integrity; not full SSA verification/lowering of every maximum graph.
No new Android application, worker/cancellation, Linux execution, complete native driver, compiler/RAM, steady-state or competitor victory claim. M4 remains incomplete; M8 is not achieved.
Historical evidence is byte-preserved and identifies its original old-format sources; current fixture data is migrated.

external_tools.purpose: Independent BF interpreters/reference oracles, canonical initial authoring/generic expected-root API orchestration, buffers/native calls/file transport only. No foreign production BFX parser or BF frontend.
